candidate_design.assignment_rule: every variant appears once in every biological library

bootstrap.procedure: resample biological libraries and batches with replacement, then variants within mutation-count strata

permutation.procedure: shuffle phenotype within biological-library, batch, and mutation-count blocks

replication_criterion: primary paired-bootstrap interval lower bound > 0 AND co-primary one-sided permutation p <= 0.05
reporting_rule: emit every frozen comparator and every locked endpoint regardless of sign
